config.selection: Fit perturbation covariance on discovery rows with row_index % 4 != 0, choose weight maximizing min(natural joint R2, fit-head removal joint fidelity) on remaining discovery rows. Refit selected covariance on all discovery. Freeze before collecting test. Natural covariance and mean come from original 2048-site discovery cache.
config.budget: Each scalar has at most 64 quadratic input covectors plus one exact linear covector. Symmetric role factorization uses 32 context and 32 change reads. Unsymmetrized secant is a diagnostic response program, not a state decoder.

hypotheses.exact: Full quadratic finite changes match native local MLP coefficients with relative RMS error <=1e-4.
hypotheses.heldout_heads: Selected mixed-metric decoder reaches >=0.80 removal fidelity on held-out odd heads and improves over natural64 by >=0.10.
hypotheses.heldout_families: Selected mixed-metric decoder improves over natural64 by >=0.10 on both half-head removal and paired-head removal.
hypotheses.natural_retention: Selected mixed-metric natural coefficient R2 is no more than 0.05 below natural64.
hypotheses.role_function: Symmetrized role32 decoder reaches >=0.80 held-out-head fidelity and stays within 0.05 of natural64 natural R2.

config.scope: Four frozen residual-selected L8 output coordinates, including two weakly recurring individual axes. No next-token labels or native-write oracle inputs. Local finite input-response tests; no full-suffix intervention in this experiment. Panels are disjoint within the continuation but not claimed globally unused.
